summary: CL Workshop Group Ltd, a Macau-domiciled lumber and wood products issuer formerly named Nature Wood Group, filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering an at-the-market (ATM) equity program of up to $200,000,000 in American Depositary Shares, each ADS representing eight Class A ordinary shares, under a September 30, 2026 sales agreement with Chaince Securities, LLC as sales agent. Sales occur at prevailing market prices with a 3.0% commission; no escrow. ADSs trade on Nasdaq under NWGL at $1.46 as of September 29, 2026. Public float exceeds $75.0 million, freeing the issuer from Form F-3 I.B.5 sales caps. CEO Liying Wang controls approximately 92.82% of voting power via Class B shares. Watch dilution pace and any acceleration in ATM utilization.
